detail.title: Analysis of Counterfactual Scoring and Foundational Reasoning Limits
detail.summary: We analyze how multi-turn reasoning models exhibit distinct failure modes and behavioral shifts under external oversight, providing insight into the limits of self-correction.
detail.reason: Revising notebook findings with new evidence on reasoning failures and professional change frameworks.
